acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent mode
alkylation reagent: alkylation with 50 mM iodoacetamide at RT
alkylation concentration: alkylation with 50 mM iodoacetamide at RT
cleavage agent: digested with trypsin (Promega) at 37 °C for 4 h
enrichment method: In total, 500 μl FLAG-M2 magnetic beads (Sigma) were washed three times
fractionation method: The TMT-labeled peptides were pooled and separated into six fractions by an Ultra-micro spin C18 column
instrument: interfaced to a Thermo Fisher Q Exactive
ionization type: followed by mass spectrometry on a Sciex Triple Quad 6500 triple-quadrupole mass spectrometer in positive electrospray ionization mode
labeling: labeled with 11 different tandem mass tags (TMT; Thermo Scientific)
